_comment: multiple-version line, MC 1.18.2 forge. Runs the standalone in-client UI test harness (uitest/mv-1.18.2-forge, an independent Gradle build in this repository on ModDevGradle legacyforge) through the three-stage pipeline config->build->test; the two production (SRG-named) jars ride MDG's remapping modRuntimeOnly configuration out of a content-addressed flatDir repository inside the build, and world creation is 1.18.2's own Minecraft.createLevel (no WorldOpenFlows on this generation). The old skip's launch-path story is void for the same reason as its 1.20.1 sibling: the checkout's JPMS split package never existed here. The selection matches its two siblings (tag:smoke,tag:jei) even though this line's JECh build carries no JEI plugin class (measured 2026-10-14, when the row was skipped): its JEI bridge is the legacy ASM coremod coremods/jei_transformer.js plus me.towdium.jecharacters.utils.FakeTree, and the harness taps that tree itself (FakeTreeMixin) instead of the JechSearchStorage its 1.19.2/1.20.1 siblings tap, so the JEI scenarios' match assertions hold on this line too. Consequences of the same fact: no plugin log marker to assert (there is no 'Registering JEI pinyin search storage' line on this generation, so this env carries no jei-storage-registered check), and the harness's report is the behavioural verdict, with the failure markers alongside it. Harness-row shape, as the 1.21.1 rows carry it: no ready_when, no world, no gradle block, and every artifact via=dev-classpath (the standalone build loads everything itself; a jt-staged copy would double-load).
